name: Hilda
source: The First Unit's second-in-command after Zola, her lover and the ex-captain, was killed and one of the "veteran" ParaMail riders. She acts quite hostile towards Ange and displays a cynical view of the world. However, according to the others, Hilda used to have the same personality as Ange when she first came into Arzenal.
